title: pelargonium undulatum
intro: Pelargonium undulatum, commonly known as Cape Lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium undulatum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve headaches, and calm anxiety, all attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Pelargonium undulatum are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and herbal remedies.
